proves.claim: A failed unskipped case routes to the authenticated owner selected by its exact shard while preserving its defining source, full name, signature, head and shard provenance.

api.gate-owner.routes-authenticated-fail.why: Without a same-shard owner route, the comparison dispatches a shared fixture instead of the selected wrapper that ran it.

proves.claim: Foreign, malformed, skipped, duplicate or missing owner evidence cannot route a case; identical source/name pairs in separate shards resolve only to each shard's selected wrapper, and legacy receipts keep source-path behavior.

api.gate-owner.rejects-foreign-and-malfo.why: Without shard-local validation, a case could borrow another wrapper's owner or input key.

proves.claim: A routed case retry selects the authenticated wrapper path and does not retry the defining fixture.

api.gate-owner.retry-dispatches-authenti.why: Without carrying the derived routing identity into retry selection, a correct comparison can still rerun the fixture instead of the selected test.
